biw_news.title: Audi's Next A4 Delayed Until 2029 As VW's New EV Platform Falls Behind
biw_news.summary: The delay of Volkswagen's Scalable Systems Platform (SSP) directly impacts Audi's body-in-white strategy and structural architecture rollout for upcoming EVs. Structural engineers must adjust modular floor pan hardpoints, battery enclosure integration, and crash load path designs tied to the unified platform.

biw_news.title: Maserati’s Next Electric Cars Could Be A Large GT And SUV: Report
biw_news.summary: Maserati's upcoming electric GT and SUV models leverage shared EV architectures across international assembly partnerships. Structural engineers will focus on body-in-white tolerance management, multi-material joining strategies, and torsional rigidity optimization for the large-format platforms.
